svg.title: Three Crowns: a map for 3 kings and their peasants
svg.desc: Each king holds a cliff-top keep on the rim, reached by one ramp. Its three peasants farm the slope below and look across the Commons, a low basin in the middle with the richest metal. Edge hills keep the kings apart; peasants meet their neighbours on the ring road between the realms.
svg.text: 3 kings, 3 peasants each · 20 × 20 map (10240 game units square) · 3 teams of 4, 12 players
Each king holds a cliff-top keep on the rim, reached by one ramp. Its three peasants farm the slope
below and look across the Commons, a low basin in the middle with the richest metal. Edge hills keep
the kings apart; peasants meet their neighbours on the ring road between the realms.
Heights: rim 220 · slopes 190 to 160 · the Commons 140 · keeps 340
Planet Harvest · an autumn forest world
Ground: russet leaf litter and stubble fields on the slopes, golden grass in the Commons, grey
limestone on the keep mesas, muddy lanes.
Plants: oaktree_a, oaktree_b, oaktree_c and birchtree woods between the realms, orangemushrooms and
ferns under them, open fields round the peasants.
Features: rocks30_moss on the edge hills, rocks30_def beside the ramps, crateorange and crateyellow
as market stalls in the Commons.
Sky and weather: low amber sun, morning mist; wind 5 to 15; tidal 0.
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the centre. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
